rateLimited: Too many requests right now. Please try again in a moment.
requestFailed: We couldn’t complete that request. Please try again.
writeUncertain: The server didn’t answer, so whether this was saved isn’t known. It’s read again once you’re connected.
serverUnreachable: Can’t reach the server. Try again once it’s connected.
readUnanswered: Can’t reach the server. It’s read again once you’re connected.
unreachableOpenPage: Couldn’t open the page: the server can’t be reached.
unreachableCreatePage: Couldn’t create the page: the server can’t be reached.
unreachableSave: Couldn’t save the change: the server can’t be reached.

backend.onlyOwnersAssignAdmin: Only workspace owners can assign the admin role.
backend.onlyOwnersManageAdmins: Only workspace owners can manage admins.
backend.onlyOwnersRemoveAdmins: Only workspace owners can remove admins.
backend.ownersCannotChangeRole: The workspace owner’s role can’t be changed here. Transfer ownership first.
backend.ownersCannotBeRemoved: The workspace owner can’t be removed. Transfer ownership first.
backend.cannotChangeOwnRole: You can’t change your own workspace role.
backend.cannotRemoveSelf: You can’t remove yourself from the workspace.
backend.onlyAssignableRoles: Only admin, member, and guest roles can be assigned.
backend.memberNotFound: That workspace member was not found.
backend.transferTargetMustBeMember: Choose another member to transfer ownership to.
backend.emailInvalid: That email address doesn’t look right.
backend.externalGuestDisabled: External guest invitations are disabled by organization policy.
backend.verifiedDomainRequired: Organization members must use a verified organization domain.
backend.workspaceUrlInUse: That workspace URL is already in use.
backend.mcpConnectionsFull: You’ve reached the agent connection limit. Disconnect one you no longer use in Settings → Features → Agents, then try again.
backend.mcpConnectionHttpsRequired: This server’s address isn’t HTTPS, so agents can’t connect to it. Turn on a public address, or open Leafen at its localhost address and connect there.
backend.mcpConnectionCodesFull: Too many connection codes haven’t been used yet. Codes expire after 10 minutes, so try again shortly.
backend.invitationsFull: Too many invitations are pending. Cancel some first.
backend.dlpPolicyBlocked: Your organization’s data loss prevention policy blocks this.
backend.organizationStorageLimitExceeded: Your organization’s storage limit is reached, so this couldn’t be uploaded. Ask an organization admin to raise the limit or clear out files.
backend.appVersionRevoked: An app catalog revoked this version, so it wasn’t installed. Upload another version.
backend.appInTrash: This app is in Trash, so it wasn’t updated. Restore it from the list of apps, then update it.
backend.appInTrashAskAdministrator: This app is in Trash, so it wasn’t added. Ask an administrator to restore it.
backend.serverDiskLow: The server’s disk is almost full, so this couldn’t be saved. Ask the server’s administrator to free space; it works again once there is room.
backend.organizationStorageRecounting: Your organization’s storage usage is being recalculated, so uploads must wait a moment. Try again shortly.
backend.samlFieldsRequired: Fill in the issuer, the identity provider’s login URL and its certificate.
backend.samlIssuerInvalid: The issuer must be a URL or URN, such as https://idp.example.com/metadata.
backend.samlLoginUrlNotHttps: The identity provider’s login URL must start with https://.
backend.samlCertificateInvalid: The certificate must be one X.509 certificate in PEM form, starting with -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----.
backend.samlEnforcementNeedsSso: Turn SAML SSO on before requiring it.
backend.legalHoldKeeps: A legal hold protects this, so it can’t be deleted. You can delete it once the hold is released.
backend.memberDeactivated: This person is deactivated in the organization, so they can’t be added. An organization admin has to reactivate them first.
backend.samlLinkedWorkspaceInvalid: The linked workspace must be one of the organization’s workspaces.
backend.samlRequiredPerson: This person’s organization allows only single sign-on (SSO). Tell them to log in with their company account.
backend.permissionDenied: Your access here doesn’t allow this change. Ask someone who can edit it to give you access.
backend.notionMigrationMovedBefore: This was already moved into this workspace, or is being moved, so a new import would make every page twice. To bring only what changed in Notion, press “Import changes again” on the earlier move.
